rules.title: CI runs on every pull request
rules.detail: A pipeline builds and tests each pull request automatically. Merging is blocked when the pipeline fails.
rules.detection_hint: Look for evidence in repo config and CI files that: A pipeline builds and tests each pull request automatically.

rules.title: Linter enforced
rules.detail: A linter is configured and runs in CI with zero errors. Warnings do not hide real problems.
rules.detection_hint: Look for evidence in repo config and CI files that: A linter is configured and runs in CI with zero errors.

rules.title: Code formatter configured
rules.detail: A formatter is configured and applied consistently, either by CI check or pre-commit hook.
rules.detection_hint: Look for evidence in repo config and CI files that: A formatter is configured and applied consistently, either by CI check or pre-commit hook.

rules.title: README has setup instructions
rules.detail: A new developer can install, run, and test the project by following the README alone.
rules.detection_hint: Look for evidence in repo config and CI files that: A new developer can install, run, and test the project by following the README alone.

rules.title: No committed secrets
rules.detail: Source control contains no API keys, passwords, or private tokens. Secrets come from the environment or a secret manager.
rules.detection_hint: Look for evidence in repo config and CI files that: Source control contains no API keys, passwords, or private tokens.

rules.title: Dependency vulnerability audit
rules.detail: Dependencies are audited for known vulnerabilities in CI, and high-severity findings block the build.
rules.detection_hint: Look for evidence in repo config and CI files that: Dependencies are audited for known vulnerabilities in CI, and high-severity findings block the build.

rules.title: Unit tests exist
rules.detail: Core logic has automated unit tests that run in CI and pass reliably.
rules.detection_hint: Look for evidence in repo config and CI files that: Core logic has automated unit tests that run in CI and pass reliably.

rules.title: Coverage threshold enforced
rules.detail: CI enforces a minimum test coverage percentage, and the build fails when it drops below it.
rules.detection_hint: Look for evidence in repo config and CI files that: CI enforces a minimum test coverage percentage, and the build fails when it drops below it.

rules.title: Structured logging, no stray debug prints
rules.detail: Code uses a logging wrapper with levels. Raw print or console debugging statements do not ship.
rules.detection_hint: Look for evidence in repo config and CI files that: Code uses a logging wrapper with levels.

rules.title: Error tracking enabled
rules.detail: Unhandled errors are reported to an error tracking service with enough context to act on.
rules.detection_hint: Look for evidence in repo config and CI files that: Unhandled errors are reported to an error tracking service with enough context to act on.

rules.title: Configuration comes from the environment
rules.detail: URLs, keys, and feature flags are read from environment or config files, never hardcoded in source.
rules.detection_hint: Look for evidence in repo config and CI files that: URLs, keys, and feature flags are read from environment or config files, never hardcoded in source.

rules.title: Database migrations are versioned
rules.detail: Schema changes are applied through versioned migration files kept in source control.
rules.detection_hint: Look for evidence in repo config and CI files that: Schema changes are applied through versioned migration files kept in source control.

rules.title: Release automation
rules.detail: Versioning, changelog, and publishing happen through an automated pipeline, not manual steps.
rules.detection_hint: Look for evidence in repo config and CI files that: Versioning, changelog, and publishing happen through an automated pipeline, not manual steps.

rules.title: Observability dashboards
rules.detail: Key service metrics such as latency, errors, and saturation are visible on shared dashboards with alerts.
rules.detection_hint: Look for evidence in repo config and CI files that: Key service metrics such as latency, errors, and saturation are visible on shared dashboards with alerts.

rules.title: Architecture decisions recorded
rules.detail: Significant design decisions are documented as short ADRs or architecture docs kept next to the code.
rules.detection_hint: Look for evidence in repo config and CI files that: Significant design decisions are documented as short ADRs or architecture docs kept next to the code.

rules.title: Performance budget defined
rules.detail: A measurable budget for load time, bundle size, or startup time exists and is checked in CI.
rules.detection_hint: Look for evidence in repo config and CI files that: A measurable budget for load time, bundle size, or startup time exists and is checked in CI.

rules.title: Accessibility and crash reporting
rules.detail: Interactive elements have accessible labels and contrast, and mobile builds report crashes to a crash reporting service.
rules.detection_hint: Look for evidence in repo config and CI files that: Interactive elements have accessible labels and contrast, and mobile builds report crashes to a crash reporting service.
